##### Project general facts

Samana Barari Avenue is a premium commercial development by Samana Developers, conceived as a business park reimagined for success in the heart of Majan. Blending cutting-edge architecture with high-end office spaces and prime retail outlets, it is a landmark destination where visionaries, entrepreneurs and established enterprises come together to reshape the future of business. Strategically positioned along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, the project sits within easy reach of Dunecrest American School, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport.

The development offers premium commercial spaces with scenic views, designed to support businesses from ambitious startups to global corporations. Modern architectural design with energy-efficient features is paired with expansive glazing that fills every workspace with natural light, while high-visibility storefronts at street level benefit from promising footfall throughout the day. Flexible leasing and ownership options give companies the freedom to secure exactly the space they need, making the project as attractive to occupiers as it is to investors.

Samana Barari Avenue has been conceived as a complete business environment rather than simply a place to work. State-of-the-art facilities and amenities are complemented by VIP drop-off zones, high-speed connectivity and a welcoming arrival experience that sets the tone for the working day. Green spaces, open areas and ample parking add comfort and convenience for teams and visitors alike, while the surrounding community offers a balanced mix of residential and commercial options that keeps everything close at hand.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Maijan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
